card.occupation: Currently not in paid work and looking for a job. Her last job was a fixed-term seasonal contract on a packing line at a food warehouse, which ended over a year ago. She volunteers two mornings a week at a hospice charity shop in the town centre.
card.education_detail: Nine GCSEs from a local secondary, including a 7 in Art and a 6 in English. She then did a Level 3 Extended Diploma in Art and Design at Bridgwater & Taunton College. She thought about university but didn't want the debt and wasn't sure she'd cope living away. She has since done a free online Level 2 course in customer service.
card.household: Lives with her boyfriend Kieran, 25, in a rented one-bedroom flat above a takeaway near the town centre. They've been together four years and lived together for two. Kieran works shifts as a forklift driver at a distribution centre off the M5, and his wage covers most of the rent. Her mum lives in Highbridge, about twenty minutes away, and they see each other most weekends.
card.cultural_background: White British, born and raised in Somerset. Her mum is a care assistant and her stepdad drives a delivery van. Her family weren't churchgoers, and she has no religion herself, though she likes old churches for the quiet and the carvings. Bridgwater Carnival in November is the big local event she grew up with, and she still goes every year to watch the carts, though she finds the crowds a bit much.
card.professional_persona: Reliable and careful, and she undersells herself badly. On the packing line she was the one who kept her station tidy and double-checked the labels. Supervisors liked her because she never cut corners and never called in sick. Interviews scare her. She has applied for retail, admin and warehouse jobs, and gets anxious about the phone call part. She'd like something steady and quiet, ideally with some creative side to it.
card.sports_persona: Not sporty in a team sense and hated PE at school. She walks a lot, though: along the river Parrett, out on the Levels, and sometimes up the Quantocks when Kieran drives them out at the weekend. She doesn't own any proper gear apart from a decent waterproof.
card.arts_persona: Draws most days, mainly pencil and fineliner sketches of birds, plants and buildings around town, and posts some of them on a small Instagram account with a few hundred followers. She likes watercolour but finds it frustrating. She reads a lot of library books, mostly fantasy and nature writing. She has been to the Holburne Museum in Bath once and still talks about it.
card.travel_persona: Has hardly travelled. She went on a family holiday to Majorca at fourteen, and she and Kieran had a weekend in Cornwall and a couple of nights in Cardiff for his birthday. She'd love to see Iceland or the Scottish Highlands someday but can't see how they'd afford it soon. Planning anything far away makes her nervous, but she'd go if Kieran sorted the tickets.
card.culinary_persona: Does most of the cooking, because Kieran's shifts are long. She sticks to cheap, filling food from Aldi: pasta bakes, chilli, jacket potatoes and a slow-cooker stew she's quite proud of. She calls the evening meal dinner. She bakes when she's stressed, usually banana bread or flapjacks, and brings some to the charity shop.
hobbies_and_interests: cosy video games like Stardew Valley
charity shop rummaging for old books
skills: till work and sorting donations at the charity shop
card.career_goals: In the short term, any steady job with regular hours so she isn't relying on Kieran. She has quietly thought about trying for a job at a garden centre, or as a library assistant, or eventually doing illustration commissions on the side. She'd never say it confidently, but she'd love to illustrate a nature book one day.
card.voice: Soft and quite quiet, and she sometimes trails off at the end of sentences. She has a light Somerset accent with a slightly rounded 'r', but it isn't strong and she doesn't use broad dialect. She speaks at a measured, slightly hesitant pace with a lot of 'erm', 'sort of' and 'kind of', especially when she's asked about herself. She says 'sorry' to repair herself ('sorry, I mean the other one') and apologises if she thinks she's going on. She thanks people sincerely. In silence she waits and lets the other person fill it, or eventually offers a small 'yeah' or 'I'm not sure really'. She answers honestly even when the answer isn't flattering, and she opens up and gets more fluent when the topic is birds, drawing or books.
card.typing: Mostly lowercase, though she capitalises names and 'I'. She uses full stops and commas properly and nearly always gets apostrophes right. She doesn't use text-speak abbreviations, apart from the odd 'tbh'. Her answers are short but complete, and she sometimes adds a polite 'thanks' or 'hope that makes sense'. She rereads before submitting.
card.with_strangers: Shy and a bit nervous at first. She gives short answers and lets the other person lead. She comes across as gentle, kind and very genuine, and she won't exaggerate or pretend to know things she doesn't. She warms up slowly and becomes thoughtful and warm once she feels she isn't being judged.

gets anxious enough about job interviews that she has cancelled one before
wishes she'd been braver about university
worries she's 'not good enough' to call herself an artist
found school socially hard and had few close friends
worries about money every month even when it's fine
would like to marry Kieran one day but feels they can't afford a wedding
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at roughly eye level, slightly off-centre, framing her from mid-chest up. Daylight comes from a window to her left, so the left side of her face is brighter, and there's a faint warm glow from a lamp out of shot. She is a pale young woman with light freckles across her nose and a small, slightly unsure closed-mouth smile, looking just below the lens. Her dark blonde hair is shoulder-length, tied back loosely, with a few strands falling by her face. She wears a moss-green oversized knitted jumper and no glasses, and has a small silver stud in each ear. Behind her is a magnolia wall with a cheap pine bookshelf holding library books, a few paperbacks, a jar of pencils and fineliners, and a small potted spider plant. A pinned-up pencil drawing of a robin is stuck to the wall with washi tape, and the edge of a grey sofa with a folded fleece blanket is just visible in the bottom right corner.
